summary.text: On Mirrodin, Memnarch, corrupted by Phyrexian oil, seeds the plane with mana-infused satellites and captures beings from across the Multiverse to seek planeswalker ascension, and Glissa, Slobad and Bosh confront him in the Core.
Memnarch turns the Kaldra avatar against them, and as it pursues Glissa through the Tangle to the Radix, she triggers a surge of green mana that destroys it and births the green sun, the Fifth Dawn.
Glissa and Raksha later push into the core to stop Memnarch, and Glissa and Memnarch fall into the mana core, where the souls, mana and Glissa's spark enter Slobad, who ascends, and Karn returns.
